review.summary: The executable AST and rendered rule are equivalent and exactly enforce the R1 CPU budget requirement within the declared abstraction contract. Thus only Pods selected for that node contribute, each Pod occurs once in the Pod-domain sum, and le permits equality. The rule adds no extra category obligation. review.summary: The executable rule and rendered rule exactly implement the R2 per-node shared memory budget requirement within the declared abstraction contract. Its consequence directly applies le to sum p:Pod of ite(assign(p,n), memory_request(p), 0) and free_memory(n). Thus only selected assignments contribute, all targets assigned to the same node share one budget, and equality passes. Byte units and effective-request/background accounting are correctly delegated to memory_request and free_memory by their atom contracts.
